hero.kicker: Built by and for amateur clubs
hero.sub: We've digitized everything that eats your evenings: call-ups, payments, tournaments, communication. You coach, we handle the rest.

digit.f1Body: Send, follow up, track responses. Without texting everyone individually.
digit.f2Body: Fees, equipment, camps. Stripe built in, automatic receipts, follow-ups included.
digit.f3Body: Club wall, event chat, multilingual emails. No more overflowing WhatsApp groups.
digit.f4Body: Attendance, coach feedback, progress. A real career path for your players.
digit.f5Body: Cards, suspensions, injuries tracked automatically by team and season.
digit.f6Body: Prepare the lineup, share it, export the sheet. The coach has everything on their phone.
digit.title: Everything that took you hours, now in a few clicks.
digit.sub: Every feature solves a real volunteer problem: fewer spreadsheets, fewer messages, more time on the field.
